topic: Performance Optimization Techniques: Bit Manipulation for Arithmetic Expressions
explanation: Optimizing arithmetic expressions by leveraging bitwise operations (left shifts and subtractions) can significantly improve performance in computer systems. This is because bitwise operations are typically faster than arithmetic operations like addition and multiplication, especially when dealing with power-of-two calculations. By carefully structuring expressions using bit shifts, we can reduce the number of operations, thereby decreasing execution time and improving overall program performance.
